question.text: A Cat III AIF pitch book should AVOID:

answer.text: Unverifiable or exaggerated claims about manager capability and past returns

explanation.text: The Logic: Avoid unverifiable/exaggerated claims — violates Code of Conduct (Topic 4). The Trap: Disclaimers, strategy explanation, team bios are appropriate content. Cross-Exam Context: SEBI Code-of-Conduct rule. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Stress-test every return claim with the Manager before publishing.
